name: The Friendly Fork
description: A cozy spot known for its hearty breakfasts and classic American dishes. Family-owned and operated for over 20 years, offering a warm atmosphere and generous portions.

name: Spice Route Bistro
description: Experience the vibrant flavors of India and Nepal at this charming bistro. Fresh ingredients, authentic recipes, and a welcoming ambiance make it a local favorite.

name: El Fuego Taqueria
description: Serving up the best tacos and traditional Mexican fare in San Antonio. Made with love and generations-old recipes, every bite is a fiesta!

name: Green Garden Cafe
description: A haven for plant-based eaters, offering delicious and innovative vegan and vegetarian dishes made from locally sourced, organic ingredients.
